title: harness-exchange/1
description: Front matter of one exchange (the user's message and the reply, word for word), sent after a reply by a tool's harness skill.

profile.description: The harness profile this tool account is (written into the skill).

tool.description: The tool that wrote it, e.g. claude-ai, cowork, chatgpt.

conversation.description: The conversation's summary file name without .md (the same for every save of it).

number.description: The reply's number in the conversation (1, 2, 3...).
